verdict.rationale: A Python SDK changelog page exists (jev-docs-27). Model lifecycle changes are traceable through versioned model IDs, a documented `jev-latest`/`jev-preview` alias policy, and release dates returned by `GET /v1/models`. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated model or API release-notes feed explaining what changed between versions. Missing for 10: a model-level changelog or release notes, an API/endpoint changelog beyond the Python SDK, a JavaScript SDK changelog, evidence the changelog is actively maintained, and independent corroboration.
